blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A concern involving a section of the ceiling system at SM Seaside Cebu Arena prompted the cancellation of LANY’s sold-out Cebu concert on Thursday, November 12. The Cebu City government said the concert was called off as a precautionary measure after a safety concern was identified during the sound check before the scheduled performance. Following the cancellation, the Office of the Building Official (OBO), Cebu City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CCDRRMO) and Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) conducted an initial assessment, which identified the concern as involving a specific section of the arena’s ceiling system.
